result.rationale: Keep EQT and add Sixth Street. EQT IV acquired EdgeConneX in 2020, V joined in 2021 and EQT AI Infrastructure bought a minority interest from IV/V in 2026. CPP's closed $1.75bn investment supports that EQT strategy; no primary source names CPP as a separate direct EdgeConneX shareholder.

Operates edge, hyperscale, purpose-built and build-to-density data centers for hyperscale, cloud, enterprise, content, network, technology and AI customers; 20+ countries, 80 operating/developing sites across 60+ markets and >10GW additional planned.
